text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, phew, phew... Just a little 
further... to the goal.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Off to where my Trainer is waiting for 
me~!

—There are many different forms a 
relationship between an Umamusume and her 
Trainer can take.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Hey! What kind of time is this?! I know 
you're capable of much better than this!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm so sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, the results aren't as promising as I 
hoped. What do you think?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Um, while I was running, I realized...
Meanwhile, as for me...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Goal!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, a new record~. Mm-hmm, a slightly 
better time than before♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much~ It's all thanks to 
you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu, good girl, good girl♪

"It's been like this the whole time. Not a 
single shred of strictness..."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
*pat, pat... pat, pat...* Good girl, good 
girl~ ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right. I'm sorry, you just felt 
so nice to pet.
choice_data_list:
Is it really okay for our relationship to 
be like this?

Is it really okay for our relationship to 
be like this?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh, what about it?
choice_data_list:
It's a lot more lenient than the others, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Lukewarm... Hmm, now that you mention it, 
I guess I can kind of see that~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Still, I'm sure this is for the best.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Because there is something more important 
than anything else in order for us to keep 
running together."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well~ it's all about whether you feel like 
spoiling them or not♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"As long as that part is solid, you'll be 
fine. Everyone else is like that to some 
degree or another, after all."

Super Creek, brimming with motherly 
instincts. Our partnership began when she 
reverse-scouted me.

"To be honest, I don't think it's like 
anyone else's. But it's also true that 
this is the dynamic that works for the two 
of them..."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: And so, it begins. Our Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It looks like it's going to be a long 
challenge, but it'll be alright.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I will definitely protect you.

Afterward, the two of them discussed their 
future goals.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, first and foremost, it's definitely 
claiming the Classics. The Satsuki Sho, 
the Derby, and the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Becoming a Classic Trainer is a dream for 
anyone, after all♪"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
At least one of them. Preferably all of 
them...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I want to win it for them. For my precious 
Trainer.
choice_data_list: Creek's the one who'll take it...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
“Still, please take all the glory for 
yourself, Trainer. It is enough for me 
simply to be of assistance.”

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Just seeing you happy makes me happy, 
Trainer♪ Now, let's do our best.

I feel like something's a bit off. Even 
so, that was how their Twinkle Series 
began.

On one side, a highly promising Umamusume. 
On the other, a fledgling rookie Trainer. 
The gap between them was considerable.

I had to improve my own skills while 
leading her to success. But the sky we 
aimed for was still far away.
